description: Local service harness — real Docker compose smoke

files.docker-compose.yml: PostgreSQL 17-alpine, Redis 7-alpine, MinIO latest — health checks, volumes, dev credentials (kms/kms_dev/kms)
files.docker-compose.test.yml: Test override: isolated ports (5433/6380/9002-9003), test credentials (kms_test/kms_test/kms_test)

postgres.smokeResult: PASS — healthcheck healthy; real psql connection as kms_test succeeded; PostgreSQL 17.10 confirmed; CREATE/INSERT/SELECT/DROP round-trip succeeded

redis.smokeResult: PASS — healthcheck healthy; redis-cli ping returned PONG

minio.smokeResult: PASS — healthcheck healthy; 'mc ready local' returned 'The cluster local is ready'

smokeTestStatus: PASS — all three services healthy on first probe; teardown clean (volumes + network removed)

commands.smoke: docker exec <pg> pg_isready -U kms_test -d kms_test && docker exec <redis> redis-cli ping && docker exec <minio> mc ready local

caveat: POSTGRES_USER/DB only initialize on an EMPTY data directory. A pre-existing pgdata volume initialized with dev user 'kms' caused the test override (kms_test) to be ignored until 'down -v' reset the volume. Run 'down -v' when switching credential sets.
